prompt: Your pm-head run fires at ~22:47. The presence lane synced DotCollab at 22:37 (quiet, 3 MUST ACKs already handled by that lane) and the agent-watch lane synced at 22:42 (0 new items). Should you run your own DotCollab sync this run?
